final: WITH rating_values AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio_of_averages, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, ratio_of_averages, film_count, ratio_of_averages - (SELECT AVG(ratio_of_averages) FROM rating_values) AS difference_from_rating_average FROM rating_values ORDER BY rating
